title: Certain 2023-2025 Model Year Escape and Corsair, 2024-2025 Model Year Nautilus, 2025-2026 Model Year Bronco Sport and 2025 Model Year Maverick Vehicles Equipped with an Engine Block Heater System -Block Heater Replacement
owner_letter_1_remedy: Parts are not available. Ford is working to provide parts for this repair. When the remedy becomes available, Ford will notify you via mail to schedule a service appointment with your dealer for repairs to be completed free of charge. The remedy is anticipated to be available by the fourth quarter of 2025.
owner_letter_2_remedy: Ford has authorized your dealer to perform one of the two following remedies: Parts are not available. Ford is working to provide parts for this repair. When the remedy becomes available, Ford will notify you via mail to schedule a service appointment with your dealer for repairs to be completed free of charge. The remedy is anticipated to be available by the fourth quarter of 2025. An alternate remedy is also available for owners who would like to disable the vehicle’s block heater. For those customers that choose this option, Ford has authorized your dealer to remove the block heater element and power cable and install a threaded plug free of charge. If the block heater element is removed under this alternate remedy, the dealer will store the power cable in the vehicle’s trunk compartment and your vehicle will be automatically added to Customer Satisfaction Program 25B33. Once parts to support the block heater remedy become available, Ford will authorize your dealer to install the block heater element free of charge.
owner_letter_3_remedy: Ford has authorized your dealer to perform one of the two following remedies: • Have the block heater disabled: If you choose this option, Ford has authorized your dealer to remove the block heater element and power cable and install a threaded plug free of charge. If the block heater element is removed under this alternate remedy, the dealer will store the power cable in the vehicle’s trunk compartment, and your vehicle will be automatically added to Customer Satisfaction Program 25B33. Once parts to support the block heater remedy become available, Ford will authorize your dealer to install the block heater element free of charge. • Wait for the new block heater remedy parts: Parts are not available. Ford is working to provide parts for this repair. When the remedy becomes available, Ford will notify you via mail to schedule a service appointment with your dealer for repairs to be completed free of charge. The remedy is anticipated to be available in June 2026. If you choose to leave the block heater element installed and wait for the remedy block heater due out later this year, no action is necessary. However, to reduce the risk of an underhood fire, refrain from plugging in your engine block heater system until remedy parts are available and repair is completed.
owner_letter_4_remedy: A remedy and the necessary parts are now available to repair your vehicle. Ford has authorized your dealer to perform this service free of charge. Your dealer will install a new engine block heater, as well as inspect the power cable, and replace it if damaged. To reduce the risk of an underhood fire, refrain from plugging in your engine block heater system until the repair is completed.
